title: pinus nigra subsp. fenzleyi
intro: Pinus nigra subsp. fenzleyi, commonly known as Black Pine, is a subspecies of evergreen tree within the Pinus nigra species. This plant is known for its therapeutic properties, including its use in traditional medicine to aid in wound healing, reduce inflammation, and alleviate respiratory issues. The health benefits of Black Pine include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as soothing irritated skin and reducing fever. The bioactive constituents of Black Pine include terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
